content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lincoln

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific eligibility criteria—education level, years of experience, and contact hours—to confirm you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Lincoln-based cohorts meet on a schedule designed for working professionals. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide, real-world case studies, and exam-domain topics across the full contact-hour requirement in an interactive classroom environment.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMI application through the PMI website, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Our team will guide you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor feedback—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in Lincoln or online. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, you'll enter PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PMP® renewal programs and continuing-education courses to help you maintain your credential and stay current.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
